module_summary: 2-bit ripple-carry adder built from two chained add1 full-adder instances linked by an internal carry.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: 2-bit operand A split bitwise into the two full adders.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: 2-bit operand B split bitwise into the two full adders.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 2-bit sum assembled from both full-adder outputs.

anchors.name: Co
anchors.why: Carry-out from the upper full adder.

anchors.name: Cin
anchors.why: Carry-in feeding the low-bit full adder.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Ripple carry from bit-0 adder into bit-1 adder.

groups.name: ripple_carry_chain
groups.description: Two add1 full adders chained through Co_temp to form a 2-bit adder.
